profile.headline: Software Engineer at Tesla
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer with a variety of experience in web-based technologies. I have a strong passion for solving complex problems with software. While I've encountered a number of challenges throughout my career, I've always been able to overcome these by finding the technologies that are best suited for the problem.

In the last few years I've worked with a fantastic team to rebuild the eCommerce website at AAAS using a modern and responsive technology stack. It was a challenging endeavor as I was under a tight and an unyielding deadline. Nevertheless, I was able to deliver a stable and customer friendly storefront experience that is still heavily used today.

In addition to the eCommerce site, I've also been involved in building and designing .NET based web applications that are used by internal and external customers. These web applications use the latest front-end (angular 2+, ASP.NET MVC) and back-end (.NET Web API, Entity Framework) technologies.

I look forward to discovering new challenges and confident that my skillset will provide me with the tools needed to deliver fantastic products.

projects.title: Differencing Methods in Differential Equations
projects.description: Partial differential equations often appear in many physical models and problems and can be very hard to solve exactly. Often, it is more beneficial to simply run an approximation algorithm in most cases. There are certain special partial differential equations that have relatively simple but accurate methods of approximating the solutions at discrete mesh points. This project uses differencing methods to approximate the solution to these special differential equations.
